name: Red Sea
description: Follow Red Sea, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Saudi Arabia has few options as it faces mounting threats from Iran and its allies
changes.summary: A lightning advance by Houthi rebels threatens a crucial Red Sea shipping route. Drone attacks blamed on Iraqi militias have forced the closure of a major pipeline, and Iran is still disrupting the Strait of Hormuz.

changes.title: Why Mokha, Historic Port That Shaped the Coffee Trade, Is a Prize in Yemen’s War
changes.summary: A strategic location on the Red Sea afforded the city centuries of trading dominance — and makes it a coveted target in today’s fighting in the Middle East.

changes.title: Saudi Arabia forced to shut down crucial Red Sea pipeline after attacks
changes.summary: The Iran-backed Houthi militia captured a strategic Red Sea port city this week. NPR's Scott Simon talks to April Longley Alley of the Washington Institute.

changes.title: Yemen's Iranian-backed Houthis seize an island in a key strait, opening a new front in the Iran war
changes.summary: Yemen's Iranian-backed Houthi rebels captured a strategic island at the southern entrance to the Red Sea, two officials said Friday, opening a new front in the Iran war and further threatening Saudi oil exports through one of the world's key shipping lanes.

changes.title: Tankers Sail Through Red Sea Despite Houthi Blockade
changes.summary: Dozens of ships continued to traverse the Red Sea this week, but with scattered disruption, uncertainty about the passage grows by the hour.

changes.title: Saudi military strikes Houthi targets in Yemen after Iran-backed militia attacked Red Sea shipping
changes.summary: Saudi Arabia intercepted two ballistic missiles from Yemen, Greek security sources told Reuters, as fighting in a second front in the Iran war escalates.

changes.title: Trump Vows Retaliation Against Iran for Houthi Attack in Red Sea
changes.summary: President Donald Trump is vowing retaliation against Iran, saying he is considering a “massive attack” after Houthi rebels struck two Saudi oil tankers in the Red Sea. The attack pushed international oil prices above $100 a barrel for the first time since May. NBC’s Richard Engel reports and Meet the Press moderator Kr.

changes.title: Oil surges to $100 per barrel. And, Trump imposes a new round of tariffs
changes.summary: Oil surged to $100 per barrel after Iran-backed Houthi rebels attacked two Saudi tankers in the Red Sea. And, President Trump overnight replaced expiring tariffs with a slew of new ones. (Image credit: Kevin Dietsch).

changes.title: Trump threatens 'major military punishment' after Houthi attacks on tankers in Red Sea
changes.summary: International oil prices topped $100 a barrel after Houthi rebels in Yemen claimed they attacked two oil tankers in the Red Sea, raising new fears of disruptions to global energy supplies.
